name: Sonicare
description: A documented GATT map and discovery helpers for Philips Sonicare handles. Explore the characteristics and notifications without depending on the manufacturer’s app.
capabilities: Classify advertised Sonicare service and handle families.
Inspect the live handle’s exposed characteristics.
Subscribe to notifications from a tested handle.
Most notification layouts and SACP writes remain open.
tested: Checked with BLE probe on macOS against a handle reporting HX999X and firmware 1.13.4.
limits: The library is not integrated into a hub. Receiving a notification does not mean every field in it has been decoded.
code:
from openble.sonicare.identify import classify
from openble.sonicare.uuids import cbt

families, evidence = classify("Philips Sonicare", [cbt("0001")])
print(families)  # ['toothbrush']
next: Use the discovery helpers and protocol manual in your own client.

devices.notes: Checked with BLE probe on macOS against a handle reporting HX999X and firmware 1.13.4.
